decisions.reason: This door lever handle family sits at the firm's core, carries sunk design and tooling investment, and was still promoted in 2019, so management is inclined to keep it despite the lack of recent evidence.

This handle design is close to the established range and remained visible after launch, so the investment already made and the firm's design reputation favour keeping it, though single designs are rotated more easily than families.

The L700 LightAccess system was publicly announced as unique on the market, was upgraded to a Pro version, and is central to the firm's stated move toward digital building organisation, so commitment to it is strong and any weak results would be put down to market ramp-up.
